player_prompt.intro:
Uri umukinnyi {player_id} muri Chopsticks. Ku ngiro yawe, hita moja ya:
  + Kugonga:  '[attack M O]'  aho M=ikiganza cye (0 cyangwa 1), O=ikiganza cya mpanzi (0 cyangwa 1).
    - Amatwi ya mpanzi yanongezeka na ikiganza cye; niba >=5, ikiganza kisigara.
  + Kugabanya:   '[split L R]'  kugabanya amatwi yawe yose muri L na R (L+R = amatwi yawe yose).
Sobanura na kimwe kimwe muri iyo komandi.

invalid_move.split_no_change: Utegerezwa kuba uhinduye ukuntu ukuboko kwawe gukwiragiye.
invalid_move.invalid_command: Kusogea kisichohalali. Utumie “[attack M O]” au “[split L R]”.

game_action.attack: P{player_id} atumbera ukuboko kwa P{opp_id} {opp_idx}: kuva kuri {opp_val} gushika ku {new_val}.
